{{Top|leg}}
The '''flith''' was a particularly hearty variety of flower found in the wastelands on [[Lorista]], a planet colonized by the Zabrak. Flith was also a common name for Zabrak females.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
